note: A picture accepted onto fal’s queue on the entry’s TEXT WIRE — the call the canonical picture is made with, which carries no reference at all (S-128). D-027's ladder makes the canonical from nothing and every later picture from that one, and fal's published schemas make `image_urls` a REQUIRED field on three of the four admitted edit wires, so a canonical sent to an edit wire is refused 422 before anything is made. The body is the same accepted-onto-the-queue shape as `fal-image-submitted`; what differs is the PATH, which is the entry's `textSlug` rather than its `slug`. Both wires of one model are polled at the same place, because fal polls the FIRST TWO SEGMENTS of a slug (`requestPath`). DOCUMENTED SHAPE, NEVER SEEN HERE: nothing in this repository had called fal when this was written, and Slice 8’s hand-run reel is what verifies it.
